mapper.update: UPDATE sr_learning_session SET summary_json=#{summaryJson} WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND id=#{id} AND summary_json IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,account_id,session_type,study_round,study_plan_id,study_task_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,status,requested_item_count,summary_json,started_at,completed_at,abandoned_at,summary_json FROM sr_learning_session WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND session_type='INITIAL_STUDY' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT account_id FROM sr_learning_account_lock WHERE account_id=#{accountId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id,p.account_id,p.tutorial_id,p.name,p.status,p.target_cards_per_task,p.study_round,p.created_at,p.updated_at,t.title tutorial_title,t.slug tutorial_slug FROM sr_study_plan p LEFT JOIN sr_tutorial t ON t.id=p.tutorial_id WHERE p.account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC
SELECT id,account_id,tutorial_id,name,status,target_cards_per_task,study_round,created_at,updated_at FROM sr_study_plan WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT p.id,p.account_id,p.tutorial_id,p.name,p.status,p.target_cards_per_task,p.study_round,p.created_at,p.updated_at,t.title tutorial_title,t.slug tutorial_slug FROM sr_study_plan p LEFT JOIN sr_tutorial t ON t.id=p.tutorial_id WHERE p.account_id=#{accountId} AND p.status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','PAUSED') ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC

SELECT p.id,p.account_id,p.tutorial_id,p.name,p.status,p.target_cards_per_task,p.study_round,p.created_at,p.updated_at,t.title tutorial_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_study_plan_chapter pc WHERE pc.plan_id=p.id AND pc.account_id=#{accountId}) total_chapters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_study_plan_chapter pc WHERE pc.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND pc.plan_id=p.id AND pc.account_id=#{accountId}) completed_chapters FROM sr_study_plan p LEFT JOIN sr_tutorial t ON t.id=p.tutorial_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_study_plan p
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_study_plan SET tutorial_id=#{row.tutorialId},name=#{row.name},target_cards_per_task=#{row.targetCardsPerTask} WHERE id=#{row.id} AND account_id=#{row.accountId} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE sr_study_plan SET status=#{status} WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.plan_id,c.account_id,c.tutorial_id,c.group_id,c.chapter_id,c.group_order,c.chapter_order,c.card_count,c.question_count,c.chapter_title, c.completed_at IS NOT NULL completed FROM sr_study_plan_chapter c WHERE c.account_id=#{accountId} AND c.plan_id=#{planId} ORDER BY c.group_order,c.chapter_order,c.chapter_id

SELECT c.chapter_id FROM sr_study_plan_chapter c JOIN sr_study_plan p ON p.id=c.plan_id WHERE p.account_id=#{accountId} AND p.status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','PAUSED')
AND p.id != #{excludePlanId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sr_study_plan_chapter WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND plan_id=#{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.plan_id,t.account_id,t.tutorial_id,t.group_id,t.study_round,t.sequence_no,t.card_count,t.question_count,t.status,t.started_at,t.completed_at FROM sr_study_task t WHERE t.account_id=#{accountId} AND t.plan_id=#{planId} AND t.study_round=(SELECT p.study_round FROM sr_study_plan p WHERE p.id=t.plan_id) ORDER BY t.sequence_no,t.id

SELECT t.id,t.plan_id,t.account_id,t.tutorial_id,t.group_id,t.study_round,t.sequence_no,t.card_count,t.question_count,t.status,t.started_at,t.completed_at FROM sr_study_task t WHERE t.account_id=#{accountId} AND t.id=#{id}

SELECT c.id,c.plan_id,c.account_id,c.tutorial_id,c.group_id,c.chapter_id,c.group_order,c.chapter_order,tc.card_count,tc.question_count,c.chapter_title,c.completed_at IS NOT NULL completed FROM sr_study_task_chapter tc JOIN sr_study_task t ON t.id=tc.study_task_id JOIN sr_study_plan_chapter c ON c.plan_id=t.plan_id AND c.chapter_id=tc.chapter_id WHERE t.account_id=#{accountId} AND t.id=#{taskId} ORDER BY tc.sequence_no,tc.id
mapper.delete: DELETE tc FROM sr_study_task_chapter tc JOIN sr_study_task t ON t.id=tc.study_task_id WHERE t.account_id=#{accountId} AND t.plan_id=#{planId} AND t.study_round=(SELECT p.study_round FROM sr_study_plan p WHERE p.id=t.plan_id)
DELETE FROM sr_study_task WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND plan_id=#{planId} AND study_round=(SELECT p.study_round FROM sr_study_plan p WHERE p.id=#{planId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_study_task SET status='IN_PROGRESS',started_at=COALESCE(started_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE sr_study_task t SET t.status='COMPLETED',t.completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE t.account_id=#{accountId} AND t.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_study_task_chapter tc WHERE tc.study_task_id=t.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_study_task_chapter tc LEFT JOIN sr_study_plan_chapter c ON c.plan_id=t.plan_id AND c.chapter_id=tc.chapter_id WHERE tc.study_task_id=t.id AND c.completed_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_study_plan sp WHERE sp.id=t.plan_id AND sp.study_round=t.study_round AND sp.status IN ('ACTIVE','PAUSED'))

UPDATE sr_study_plan p SET p.status='COMPLETED' WHERE p.account_id=#{accountId} AND p.status IN ('ACTIVE','PAUSED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_study_task t WHERE t.plan_id=p.id AND t.study_round=p.study_round) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_study_task t WHERE t.plan_id=p.id AND t.study_round=p.study_round AND t.status != 'COMPLETED')
mapper.select: SELECT id,account_id,session_type,study_round,study_plan_id,study_task_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,status,requested_item_count,summary_json,started_at,completed_at,abandoned_at FROM sr_learning_session WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT id,account_id,session_type,study_round,study_plan_id,study_task_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,status,requested_item_count,summary_json,started_at,completed_at,abandoned_at FROM sr_learning_session WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND session_type='INITIAL_STUDY' AND status='IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,account_id,session_type,study_round,study_plan_id,study_task_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,status,requested_item_count,summary_json,started_at,completed_at,abandoned_at FROM sr_learning_session WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND session_type IN ('REVIEW','STABLE_AUDIT') AND status='IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_learning_session SET status=#{status},completed_at=IF(#{status}='COMPLETED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),completed_at),abandoned_at=IF(#{status}='ABANDONED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),abandoned_at) WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND id=#{id} AND status='IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: SELECT id,session_id,account_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,knowledge_card_id,card_content_version,front_text,back_markdown,source_priority,sequence_no,status,revealed_at,completed_at FROM sr_learning_session_item WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY sequence_no,id
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_learning_session_item SET revealed_at=COALESCE(revealed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND knowledge_card_id=#{cardId} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE sr_learning_session_item SET status='COMPLETED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND knowledge_card_id=#{cardId} AND status='PENDING' AND revealed_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_card_id FROM sr_learning_evidence WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND evidence_type='INITIAL'

SELECT id,account_id,session_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,knowledge_card_id,card_content_version,evidence_type,rating,previous_mastery_status,mastery_status,created_at FROM sr_learning_evidence WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND knowledge_card_id=#{cardId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC

SELECT id,account_id,session_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,knowledge_card_id,card_content_version,evidence_type,rating,previous_mastery_status,mastery_status,created_at FROM sr_learning_evidence WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id,account_id,knowledge_card_id,mastery_status,latest_rating,evidence_count,forgot_count,fuzzy_count,remembered_count,recent_score,last_evidence_at,latest_evidence_card_version FROM sr_knowledge_mastery WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_knowledge_mastery(account_id,knowledge_card_id,mastery_status,latest_rating,evidence_count,forgot_count,fuzzy_count,remembered_count,recent_score,last_evidence_at,latest_evidence_card_version) VALUES(#{row.accountId},#{row.knowledgeCardId},#{row.masteryStatus},#{row.latestRating},#{row.evidenceCount},#{row.forgotCount},#{row.fuzzyCount},#{row.rememberedCount},#{row.recentScore},#{row.lastEvidenceAt},#{row.latestEvidenceCardVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mastery_status=VALUES(mastery_status),latest_rating=VALUES(latest_rating),evidence_count=VALUES(evidence_count),forgot_count=VALUES(forgot_count),fuzzy_count=VALUES(fuzzy_count),remembered_count=VALUES(remembered_count),recent_score=VALUES(recent_score),last_evidence_at=VALUES(last_evidence_at),latest_evidence_card_version=VALUES(latest_evidence_card_version)
mapper.select: SELECT id,account_id,question_id,latest_version_id,version_count,answer_text,first_answered_at,last_answered_at,reference_unlocked_at FROM sr_user_question_answer WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND question_id=#{questionId}

SELECT v.id,v.answer_id,v.version_no,v.answer_text,v.answer_phase,v.created_at FROM sr_user_question_answer_version v JOIN sr_user_question_answer a ON a.id=v.answer_id WHERE a.account_id=#{accountId} AND a.question_id=#{questionId} ORDER BY v.version_no
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_user_question_answer SET latest_version_id=#{row.latestVersionId},version_count=#{row.versionCount},answer_text=#{row.answerText},first_answered_at=COALESCE(first_answered_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),last_answered_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),reference_unlocked_at=COALESCE(reference_unlocked_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE account_id=#{row.accountId} AND id=#{row.id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.question_id FROM sr_user_question_answer a JOIN sr_user_question_answer_version v ON v.answer_id=a.id WHERE a.account_id=#{accountId} AND v.answer_phase='BEFORE_REFERENCE'

SELECT id,account_id,session_type,study_round,study_plan_id,study_task_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,status,requested_item_count,summary_json,started_at,completed_at,abandoned_at FROM sr_learning_session WHERE account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY started_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_learning_session WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.sql: FROM sr_learning_session s LEFT JOIN sr_tutorial t ON t.id=s.tutorial_id LEFT JOIN sr_tutorial_chapter c ON c.id=s.chapter_id LEFT JOIN sr_study_plan p ON p.id=s.study_plan_id AND p.account_id=s.account_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT t.id,t.title FROM sr_tutorial t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_study_plan p WHERE p.tutorial_id=t.id AND p.account_id=#{accountId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_learning_session s WHERE s.tutorial_id=t.id AND s.account_id=#{accountId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_learning_session_item i WHERE i.tutorial_id=t.id AND i.account_id=#{accountId}) ORDER BY t.title,t.id
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_study_plan SET study_round=study_round+1,status='DRAFT' WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND id=#{id} AND status='COMPLETED'
UPDATE sr_study_plan_chapter SET completed_at=NULL WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND plan_id=#{id}

UPDATE sr_study_plan_chapter c JOIN sr_study_plan p ON p.id=c.plan_id JOIN sr_learning_session s ON s.study_plan_id=p.id AND s.study_round=p.study_round AND s.chapter_id=c.chapter_id SET c.completed_at=COALESCE(c.completed_at,s.completed_at) WHERE c.account_id=#{accountId} AND s.account_id=#{accountId} AND s.id=#{sessionId} AND s.status='COMPLETED'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.account_id,s.session_type,s.study_round,s.study_plan_id,s.study_task_id,s.tutorial_id,s.chapter_id,s.status,s.requested_item_count,s.summary_json,s.started_at,s.completed_at,s.abandoned_at FROM sr_learning_session s JOIN sr_study_plan p ON p.id=s.study_plan_id AND p.study_round=s.study_round WHERE s.account_id=#{accountId} AND p.account_id=#{accountId} AND p.id=#{planId} AND s.chapter_id=#{chapterId} ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,account_id,session_type,study_round,study_plan_id,study_task_id,tutorial_id,chapter_id,status,requested_item_count,summary_json,started_at,completed_at,abandoned_at FROM sr_learning_session WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND session_type='INITIAL_STUDY' AND status='IN_PROGRESS'

SELECT DISTINCT a.question_id FROM sr_learning_session_question sq JOIN sr_learning_session s ON s.id=sq.session_id JOIN sr_user_question_answer a ON a.question_id=sq.question_id AND a.account_id=s.account_id JOIN sr_user_question_answer_version v ON v.answer_id=a.id WHERE s.account_id=#{accountId} AND sq.session_id=#{sessionId} AND v.answer_phase='BEFORE_REFERENCE' AND v.version_no > sq.baseline_version
